'''Axiomatic:'''

|?Has title
|?Has entity type
|format=ul
}}

|?Has title
|?Has confidence
|format=table
|sort=Has confidence
|order=desc
}}

{{#ask: [[Has confidence::>0.9]]
|?Has title
|?Has confidence
|format=table

|order=desc

|format=table
}}
```

'''Epistemics:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Has domain::Epistemics]]
|?Has title
|?Has confidence
|format=table
}}
```

=== By Author

'''Hyperion:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Has author::Hyperion]]
|?Has title
|?Has creation date
|format=table
|sort=Has creation date
|order=desc
}}
```

----
== Workflow States

| State | Meaning | Action |
|-------|---------|--------|
| Alpha | Initial draft | Review for completeness |
| Beta | Under review | Test and validate |
| Active | Current version | Use for production |
| Deprecated | Superseded | Migrate to replacement |
| Archived | Historical | Reference only |

'''SMW Query:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Has workflow state::Active]]
|?Has title
|?Has version
|format=table
}}
```

----
== Quality Indicators

| Indicator | Meaning | Threshold |
|-----------|---------|-----------|
| ⭐ Featured | Exemplary | All standards exceeded |
| ✅ Complete | Adequate | All standards met |
| 🔄 Developing | In progress | Some standards pending |
| 📝 Draft | Initial | Structure only |
| ⚠️ Review | Flagged | Issues identified |

'''SMW Query:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Has quality indicator::⭐ Featured]]
|?Has title
|format=ul
}}
```

----
== External Resources

| Resource | URL | Purpose |
|----------|-----|---------|
| BITwiki | https://bitwiki.org | Live knowledge base |
| Repository | https://github.com/bitcoreos/bitwiki-bookmatter | Source files |
| SMW Docs | https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org | Technical reference |
| MediaWiki | https://www.mediawiki.org | Platform docs |

----
== Conclusion

This master navigation provides entry points to all BITwiki book matter. Use SMW queries to explore dynamically, or follow the structured paths above.

'''Navigation Principles:'''
* Start with Front Matter for orientation
* Consult Constitutional for principles
* Reference Ontology for definitions
* Apply Evidence-Epistemics for validation
* Use Schema-Matter for implementation
* Follow Governance for operations

'''Next Steps:'''
# Explore by domain using queries
# Check Validation for quality status
# Review Research for background
# Contribute following established patterns
